title: estate.agent.event
description: One row of an agent's live mind (MUM-287, FleetView part two): what a session is doing, emitted on subjects estate.agent.<runtime>.<session_id>.<kind> with kinds phase / tool / wait / done / steer. The subject family and schema are one (docs/specs/2026-09-08-fleetview-live-mind-steering-and-the-board-view.md, 'one subject family, one schema'). An adapter that emits a row this schema refuses fails CI. Fields pin the spec; the `tool` field names a file, command or URL target, never its output; `at` is UTC RFC3339.

session_id.description: the agent session id this row belongs to

runtime.description: which process emits the row; adapters map each runtime's own record (hook ledger, Temporal history, session API, Langfuse trace, run state)

kind.description: which kind of row: a phase change, a tool call, a wait, a done, a mid-flight steer

tenant.description: which tenant's fleet this row belongs to (decision 0021: a tenant sees only its own fleet)

at.description: when the row happened, UTC RFC3339

phase.description: the session phase (or the phase being entered when kind=phase)

name.description: the tool name, e.g. bash, read, delegate

target.description: what the tool acts on: a file path, a shell command or a URL. Never the tool's output.

tool.description: present when kind=tool: what tool ran and on what, never its output

trace_id.description: the Langfuse trace id for the call, when the runtime records one

needs.description: what a waiting phase waits for, in one sentence (present when phase=waiting)

text.description: the steering instruction, in the founder's or an operator's words

author.description: the identity of the person steering; the estate never runs a steer with no attributed author

audit_row.description: the audit ledger row id that already recorded this steer (the estate writes the audit row first)

steer.description: present when kind=steer: a human corrected the session mid-flight, already on the audit ledger

examples.needs: the founder approves scaling the node pool

steer.text: stop, look in the auth folder instead
